environment.gpu: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU (0x00002D59) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
environment.note: RTX 5060 laptop, AC power, spryte 0.4.2 re-run

method.timing: simulation through GPU completion (1-pixel readback); median per count per round, then median across rounds. simMs is the shared simulation's part.
method.startup: fresh page per round: readyMs since navigation, createMs for adapter setup (lazy library import included), firstFrameMs for the first 1,000-sprite frame through GPU completion

results.label: PixiJS Sprite
results.setup: Application (WebGL, roundPixels, no antialias, no ticker); one Sprite per sprite, anchor 0.5, created once; properties the scene uses are set each frame. Churn: dead Sprites are removed and destroyed, new ones created and added. Render target: sprites in a Container rendered to a RenderTexture (nearest), shown by a scaled Sprite. Clip: a Container per panel with a rectangle Graphics mask. Upload: a Sprite of the layer, texture.source.update() each frame. Text: one Text per label (canvas-rasterised, resolution 1), string set each frame. Slice scenes: a cached Texture per source rectangle on the shared source, and a pool of Sprites shown or hidden as the count changes.

results.label: PixiJS ParticleContainer
results.setup: Application as for Sprite; one ParticleContainer with dynamicProperties set to exactly what the scene changes per frame (position, plus rotation, scale and color where used). Churn: dead particles removed with removeParticles, new ones created and added. Render target and upload as for Sprite.

results.label: spryte draw.sprite
results.setup: createRenderer(canvas, { smooth: false }); one draw.sprite per sprite with a reused options object. Slice scenes: one reused Frame object whose source rectangle changes per call. Text: draw.text with a CSS font and a reused options object. Render target: createTarget, draw.into, then the target drawn scaled. Clip: draw.clip per panel. Upload: draw.invalidate on the layer each frame.

results.label: spryte draw.sprites
results.setup: createRenderer(canvas, { smooth: false }); one draw.sprites per texture per frame, with per-copy scale, rotation and colour arrays. Render target, upload: as for draw.sprite. Clip: positions grouped per panel as they're copied, one draw.sprites per panel inside draw.clip.

results.label: Phaser Image
results.setup: Game (WEBGL, pixelArt: nearest, no antialias, roundPixels), one Scene; Phaser's loop stopped and game.step() called per frame. One Image per sprite (origin 0.5), created once with scene.add.image; properties the scene uses are set each frame (setTint + setAlpha for colour). Slice scenes: a cached texture Frame per source rectangle (texture.add), and a pool of Images (origin 0) shown or hidden, setFrame + setDisplaySize per slice.

results.label: Phaser SpriteGPULayer
results.setup: Game as for Image; one SpriteGPULayer (single texture), sized to the count. Each frame every member is rewritten with editMember from one reused member object (x, y, plus rotation, scaleX/scaleY, tint and alpha where the scene uses them); the layer re-uploads the edited buffer segments when it renders.

results.label: Phaser Blitter
results.setup: Game as for Image; one Blitter, one Bob per sprite created once with blitter.create; x and y set each frame. Bobs have no rotation or scale, so only position-only scenes.

results.label: Canvas 2D drawImage
results.setup: getContext('2d', { alpha: false }), imageSmoothingEnabled = false, one drawImage per sprite (the nine-argument form for slices). Text: fillText with textBaseline top. Render target: an offscreen canvas drawn scaled. Clip: save, rect, clip, restore per panel. Upload: the layer canvas drawn directly.
